# teams_guest_messaging_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing GuestMessagingConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_giphy` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowGiphy parameter.
- `allow_immersive_reader` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowImmersiveReader parameter.
- `allow_memes` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMemes parameter.
- `allow_stickers` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowStickers parameter.
- `allow_user_chat` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowUserChat parameter.
- `allow_user_delete_chat` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowUserDeleteChat parameter.
- `allow_user_delete_message` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowUserDeleteMessage parameter.
- `allow_user_edit_message` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowUserEditMessage parameter.
- `giphy_rating_type` (String) Maps to the -GiphyRatingType parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
